name: Kotarou
source:
[i]"Anyway, Towa, what are you up to out here?"[/i]

A hotheaded Takasato-gumi foot soldier whose primary job is to collect debt repayments. Can generally be found with his friends Mayu and Eiji.

[From the digital manual included with r59230]
